descriptions.Spellcasting:
Artificer is an Intelligence half-caster beginning at level 1. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Intelligence modifier; spell attack = PB + Intelligence modifier. Prepare Intelligence modifier + half Artificer level rounded up Artificer spells (minimum 1), plus Specialist spells. Cantrips: 2 at level 1, 3 at 10. You may replace one Artificer cantrip after recovery. All Artificer spells require a tool, crafted focus, or active piece of artifice as spellcasting focus unless the spell's nature makes that impossible.
Tinker's Magic — level 1
You always know Mending; it does not count against cantrips. With 1 minute and tools, imbue a Tiny mundane object with one simple effect lasting until you dismiss it or exceed your limit (Intelligence modifier objects, minimum 1): 5-foot bright light; recorded 6-second sound repeated on touch; static visual/symbol/scent; simple directional vibration; or another equally minor sensory/mechanical trick. You can also fabricate ordinary Tiny mundane components from appropriate raw material when a competent craftsperson could reasonably do so.
Open Artifice — level 1
You may design original devices by combining known material properties, magical principles, tools, and mechanisms. Player proposes concept/material logic; DM sets feasibility, missing requirements, build difficulty, time, cost, limits, risks, and final mechanics. Creativity cannot create properties unsupported by components/principles. Standard class features must still function without rare loot.
The First Prototype — player prerequisite
Before final character approval, complete one DM design exercise using a supplied material/property list. Preferred task: create one original item using at least 2–3 materials and explain each contribution. Alternate reverse-engineering/problem prompts are valid. This is a class-fit check, not an optimization exam. The successful prototype normally becomes a low-power starting character item.
Material Journal — level 1
Maintain a record of properties your character has discovered. Player knowledge from DM vault does not equal character knowledge. A material entry can contain physical, magical, biological, environmental, cultural, and failure properties discovered through play.
Schematics / Replicate Magic Item — level 2
Know 4 Schematics at level 2, 6 at 6, 8 at 10, 10 at 14, 12 at 18. After recovery replace one known Schematic. A Schematic is a tested repeatable design equivalent in power to an approved magic item appropriate to your Artificer level. You may maintain replicated items equal to PB simultaneously. Creating/reconfiguring one requires tools and 1 minute if components are on hand. Replicated artifice is temporary class-supported engineering and cannot be sold as permanent magic-item industrial output.
Material Analysis — level 2
With 10 minutes study and appropriate tools/check, learn one significant property of unfamiliar material on success, plus one additional property for every 5 by which check exceeds DC. Typical checks: Arcana, Investigation, Nature, Medicine, or relevant tool using Intelligence. Failure can still reveal obvious physical facts; dangerous testing may have consequences. Repeated advanced study can reveal hidden properties.
Artificer Specialist — level 3
Choose Specialist; features at 3, 5, 9, 15.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose feat/ASI.
Tool Expertise — level 6
Double PB on checks with tools in which proficient.

descriptions.Spell-Storing Item: After recovery, store one Artificer spell of 1st–3rd level with Action casting time in a weapon/tool/focus you touch. Choose spell and set uses = 2 × Intelligence modifier (minimum 2). A creature holding item can use Action to produce spell using your spell attack/DC; it requires concentration from the user if spell does. One stored item at a time.
descriptions.Masterwork Artifice: You are qualified to attempt Masterwork projects: advanced personal-scale creations combining multiple unusual principles/materials (adaptive armour, sophisticated magical engines, advanced prosthetics, autonomous devices, etc.). This grants permission/competence, not free items. Great Works remain campaign-scale projects requiring institutions/resources.
descriptions.Magic Item Master: Attune to 6 magic items. When you fail a saving throw, you may end attunement to one currently attuned item as Reaction to reroll save and use new result; the item cannot be reattuned until after recovery.
descriptions.Soul of Artifice:
While attuned to at least one magic item, gain +1 to all saving throws per attuned item, maximum +6.
When damage would reduce you to 0 HP, Reaction destroy one of your replicated items within 30 feet or end one Masterwork's active magical function until repaired; drop to 1 HP instead. Once per recovery cycle and counts against Rescue Limit. A destroyed replicated item cannot be recreated until after recovery.

descriptions.Unarmoured Defence: While not wearing armour, AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You may use a shield.
descriptions.Weapon Mastery: Choose 2 weapons with which you are proficient. You can use their Mastery properties. At levels 4 and 10, master one additional weapon (maximum 4). After a recovery cycle you may replace one mastered weapon with another eligible weapon. Terravale Light/Nick rules apply.
descriptions.Danger Sense: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see or otherwise perceive, provided you are not Blinded, Deafened to the relevant cue, or Incapacitated.
descriptions.Reckless Attack: When you make your first Strength-based attack on your turn, you may declare Reckless Attack. Strength-based attacks you make this turn have advantage; attack rolls against you have advantage until the start of your next turn.
descriptions.Primal Knowledge: Gain proficiency in one Barbarian skill. While raging, you may use Strength instead of the normal ability for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks when the method can plausibly be expressed through physical intensity, instinct, posture, breath, movement, or force. The DM may reject an application that is purely intellectual/social with no physical method.
descriptions.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
descriptions.Fast Movement: Speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armour.
descriptions.Feral Instinct: Advantage on initiative. If Surprised at the start of combat, you can act normally on your first turn if you enter Rage before doing anything else on that turn.
descriptions.Instinctive Pounce: When you enter Rage, move up to half your Speed as part of the same Bonus Action.
descriptions.Brutal Strike:
When using Reckless Attack, you may forgo advantage on one Strength-based attack. If it hits, deal +1d10 damage and choose one rider:
Forceful Blow: push target up to 15 feet if no more than one size larger.
Hamstring Blow: target Speed reduced by 15 feet until start of your next turn.
At level 13, damage becomes 2d10 and add:
Staggering Blow: target has disadvantage on next saving throw before your next turn.
Sundering Blow: next attack roll made by another creature against target before your next turn gains +5.
At level 17, Brutal Strike damage becomes 3d10, and you may apply two different riders to the same hit.
descriptions.Relentless Rage: If you drop to 0 HP while raging and do not die outright, make a Constitution save DC 10. On success, drop to 1 HP instead. Each successful use before your next recovery increases DC by 5. The DC resets after the relevant external recovery cycle. Each successful rescue counts against Terravale's universal Rescue Limit.
descriptions.Persistent Rage: Rage lasts the full 10 minutes without requiring maintenance. It ends only if you are Incapacitated or choose to end it. When initiative starts and you have no Rage uses, regain 1 Rage.
descriptions.Savage Critical: When you score a critical hit with a Strength-based weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, roll one additional weapon/Unarmed damage die. This is deliberately smaller than old Brutal Critical because Brutal Strike remains the main high-level damage feature.
descriptions.Indomitable Might: When a Strength check or Strength saving throw total is lower than your Strength score, use your Strength score as the total instead.
descriptions.Primal Champion: Strength and Constitution each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25. Rage uses are unlimited.

descriptions.Spellcasting:
Bard is a Charisma Spells Known full caster. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Charisma modifier; spell attack = PB + Charisma modifier. Terravale retains the 2014-style spellcasting-turn framework: casting a Bonus Action spell does not create the 2024 universal one-slot-per-turn rule.
Cantrips Known: 2 at level 1; 3 at level 4; 4 at level 10.
Spells Known: 4 at level 1; then 5/6/7/8/9/10/11/12/14/15/15/16/18/19/19/20/22/22/22 at levels 2–20 respectively. Magical Secrets spells do not count against these totals unless a feature says otherwise. When you gain a Bard level, replace one Bard spell known with another Bard spell you can cast.
The Bard candidate list combines approved 2014/current Bard lists. When a spell materially differs by edition, its Terravale version is chosen when selected; this is an intentional spell-system rule, not an unresolved class rule.
Bardic Inspiration — level 1
As a Bonus Action choose another creature within 60 feet that can perceive your performance. It gains one Bardic Inspiration die for 1 hour. It may roll the die after it fails an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw and add the result, potentially turning failure into success. A creature can hold only one of your dice at a time.
Uses = Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per recovery cycle. Die size: d6 levels 1–4, d8 levels 5–9, d10 levels 10–14, d12 levels 15–20.
Expertise — levels 2 and 9
Choose two skill/tool proficiencies you have at each listed level; double PB for checks using them. Expertise never stacks with itself.
Jack of All Trades — level 2
Add half PB, rounded down, to an ability check that does not already include PB, including initiative if no other feature adds PB to it.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose an eligible feat or ASI.
Font of Inspiration — level 5
Bardic Inspiration uses refresh on the faster class-resource cadence defined by Terravale's external recovery system. In addition, as a Bonus Action you may expend a spell slot to regain one Bardic Inspiration use; slot level does not change the amount.
Countercharm — level 6
When you or a creature within 30 feet that can perceive you fails a save against Charmed or Frightened, use Reaction to let that creature reroll the save with advantage. It must use the new result. Uses = Charisma modifier per recovery cycle; if you have none, expend one Bardic Inspiration instead.
Magical Secrets — levels 10, 14, 18
At each listed level learn two spells from any class spell list, of levels you can cast. They count as Bard spells for you and do not count against ordinary Spells Known. Whenever you gain a Bard level, you may replace one Magical Secret with another eligible spell.
Superior Inspiration — level 18
When initiative is rolled, if you have fewer than 2 Bardic Inspiration uses, regain uses until you have 2.
Words of Creation — level 20
Once per recovery cycle, when you cast a Bard spell of 1st–8th level that has a casting time of one Action and targets at least one creature, you may immediately echo it without expending another slot. The echo must use the same spell level and occurs immediately after the first; you may choose new legal targets/area. A costly/consumed material component must be provided again. You cannot echo a spell whose effect explicitly represents unique divine/patron authority or a spell Terravale marks nonduplicable. After using Words of Creation, you also regain all Bardic Inspiration uses.

descriptions.Spellcasting:
Cleric is a Wisdom prepared full caster. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Wisdom modifier; spell attack = PB + Wisdom modifier. Prepare a number of Cleric spells equal to Cleric level + Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), in addition to Domain spells. You may change prepared Cleric spells after the recovery/preparation period defined by Terravale. Cantrips known: 3 at level 1, 4 at level 4, 5 at level 10.
Divine Order — level 1
Choose one Order:
Protector: martial weapon proficiency, heavy armour proficiency, and Weapon Mastery with one weapon.
Thaumaturge: one additional Cleric cantrip and proficiency in Arcana or Religion; add Wisdom modifier to one Arcana/Religion check per short recovery equivalent, even if that check already uses Wisdom only if no double ability modifier occurs.
Divine Domain — level 1
Choose a Domain. Domain features arrive at 1, 2, 6, 17. Domain spells are always prepared. A Cleric normally has a real divine relationship, office, or approved equivalent; the Domain does not force a god to behave against their canon personality.
Channel Divinity — level 2
You have 2 uses at level 2, 3 at level 6, 4 at level 18. Recovery follows Terravale's class-resource cadence. You always know Divine Spark plus Domain options.
Divine Spark: Action choose creature within 30 feet. Either heal it for 2d8 + Wisdom modifier, or force it to make Constitution save; on failure it takes 2d8 radiant or necrotic (chosen on use), half success. Dice become 3d8 at level 7, 4d8 at 13, 5d8 at 18.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose eligible feat or ASI.
Sear Undead — level 5
When an undead creature fails a save against one of your Turn/Channel effects, it also takes Wisdom modifier d8 radiant damage (minimum 1d8). This feature does not redefine all undead as evil and does not override Terravale soul law.
Blessed Strikes — level 7
Choose one mode after recovery:
Divine Strike: once per turn when weapon/Unarmed attack hits, +1d8 radiant/necrotic/domain-appropriate damage.
Potent Spellcasting: add Wisdom modifier to damage of one Cleric cantrip each turn.
At level 14, Divine Strike becomes 2d8; Potent Spellcasting also grants temporary HP equal to Wisdom modifier to one creature within 30 feet when your damaging cantrip hits/fails save, once per turn.
Divine Intervention — level 10
You have two expressions:
Miracle. Action, once per recovery cycle, reproduce one Cleric spell of 5th level or lower without expending a slot or material component unless costly/consumed; it requires no preparation.
Petition. Ask your actual deity/divine authority for intervention beyond written mechanics. This is DM/canon adjudicated and may be answered, modified, delayed, refused, or carry conditions. It never makes the god a vending machine.
Greater Divine Intervention — level 20
Miracle can reproduce a Cleric spell of 8th level or lower. After making a Greater Petition, you cannot make another for a long, intentionally undefined period. The DM determines when another Greater Petition becomes possible based on the scale of the intervention, the deity involved, circumstances, consequences, and the campaign's passage of time/recovery framework. Greater Petition is exceptional divine intervention, not a predictable rest-scheduled resource. The deity treats it as an urgent direct appeal from a proven champion and will respond in some meaningful way if capable, though not necessarily exactly as requested.

descriptions.Spellcasting:
Druid is a Wisdom prepared full caster. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Wisdom modifier; spell attack = PB + Wisdom modifier. Prepare Druid level + Wisdom modifier spells (minimum 1), excluding Circle spells. Cantrips known: 2 at level 1, 3 at level 4, 4 at level 10. Spell versions follow Terravale's spell-selection policy.
Druidic — level 1
You know Druidic, a collection of spoken signs, trail marks, seasonal symbols, ritual shorthand, and regional druidic conventions. It is not one globally identical secret language; when two traditions differ, Druids can usually establish shared meaning with a few minutes of comparison. You can leave hidden messages that trained Druids notice automatically and others can detect with an appropriate Investigation/Perception check.
Primal Order — level 1
Choose one:
Magician: learn one extra Druid cantrip; add Wisdom modifier to one Arcana/Nature check per recovery where the check relates to natural/primal magic.
Warden: medium armour and martial weapon proficiency with one weapon family; Weapon Mastery with one eligible weapon.
Armour has no universal “no metal” rule; cultural/material restrictions can exist separately.
Wild Shape — level 2
As a Bonus Action, expend one Wild Shape use to transform into a Beast or approved natural Aetherfauna form you have personally observed/studied. You do not use a fixed Known Forms list.
Uses: 2 per recovery cycle; at level 17, 3. Archdruid makes uses unlimited at 20. Maximum form CR: 1/4 at level 2, 1/2 at 4, 1 at 8, unless Circle of Moon improves it. No flying Speed before level 8; no swim Speed before level 4 unless race already has it or form is a special DM-approved exception.
On transformation:
retain Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, alignment/personality, proficiencies, and class features that anatomy permits;
use form Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, AC, movement, senses, attacks;
gain temporary HP equal to Druid level + form's Constitution modifier + form CR×5 (minimum Druid level) rather than replacing your HP pool;
when temp HP are gone you remain transformed until duration ends, but further damage affects your normal HP;
duration = Druid level hours, or until dismissed as Bonus Action/incapacitated;
equipment merges, drops, or is worn if anatomy permits, chosen when transforming.
The DM may adjust a creature's stat block into a balanced Wild Shape profile; seeing a legendary/unique creature does not automatically grant legendary actions, lair actions, spellcasting, soul traits, or setting authority.
Wild Companion — level 2
Expend one Wild Shape use to perform a 1-minute rite and summon a temporary familiar-like nature spirit for up to 1 hour per Druid level, using an approved familiar form. It acts as a familiar and disappears at 0 HP/end. This creates no new soul and is not an Eidolon.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose eligible feat or ASI.
Wild Resurgence — level 5
Once per turn as Bonus Action you may expend a spell slot to regain one Wild Shape use; slot must be 1st level or higher. Once per recovery cycle, when you expend Wild Shape you may regain one expended 1st-level spell slot.
Elemental Fury — level 7
Choose after recovery:
Potent Spellcasting: add Wisdom modifier to one Druid cantrip damage roll each turn; range of Druid cantrips with 10+ foot range increases by 60 feet.
Primal Strike: once per turn weapon/Wild Shape attack deals +1d8 cold/fire/lightning/thunder or form-appropriate damage.
At level 15, Primal Strike becomes 2d8; Potent Spellcasting may add Wisdom modifier to one healing roll of a Druid cantrip/spell each turn instead of damage.
Timeless Body — level 18
For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year. You remain susceptible to magical aging if an effect explicitly bypasses this protection.
Beast Spells — level 18
While Wild Shaped, cast Druid spells normally if you can provide costly/consumed material components. Your transformed body can provide verbal/somatic components through supernatural expression even without humanoid anatomy.
Archdruid — level 20
Wild Shape uses are unlimited. Once on each of your turns when you transform, you may restore 20 temporary HP to the new/current Wild Shape form. You may ignore noncostly material components for Druid spells while Wild Shaped.

descriptions.Fighting Style: Choose one Fighting Style for which you qualify. You may replace it after gaining a Fighter level or a substantial training/recovery interval. Terravale uses its approved Fighting Style catalogue.
descriptions.Second Wind: As a Bonus Action, expend one use to regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Uses = PB per recovery cycle. At level 5, when you Second Wind you may also use Tactical Shift.
descriptions.Weapon Mastery: Master 3 weapons at level 1, 4 at level 4, 5 at level 10, 6 at level 16. After recovery, replace one mastered weapon. Fighter is the broadest baseline Weapon Mastery class.
descriptions.Action Surge: Once per recovery cycle, on your turn take one additional Action. Terravale preserves the 2014 unrestricted identity: the extra Action may be used to Cast a Spell if you can cast one. At level 17, you have 2 uses, but no more than one per turn.
descriptions.Tactical Mind: When you fail an ability check, expend Second Wind use and roll 1d10, adding it to the check. If this still fails, the Second Wind use is not expended.
descriptions.Tactical Shift: Whenever you use Second Wind as Bonus Action, move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
descriptions.Indomitable: When you fail a saving throw, reroll it and add your Fighter level to the new roll. You must use new result. Uses: 1 at level 9, 2 at 13, 3 at 17 per recovery cycle.
descriptions.Tactical Master: When you attack with a mastered weapon, you may replace its Mastery property for that attack with Push, Sap, or Slow, chosen per attack.
descriptions.Studied Attacks: When you miss a creature with an attack, you gain advantage on your next attack against that creature before end of your next turn. This advantage ends after one attack regardless of hit/miss.

descriptions.Unarmoured Defence: While not wearing armour or using a shield, AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.
descriptions.Ki:
Ki pool = Monk level. Ki save DC = 8 + PB + Wisdom modifier. Recovery follows Terravale's external class-resource cadence.
Core Ki options:
Flurry of Blows (1 Ki): Bonus Action, make two Unarmed Strikes.
Patient Defense (1 Ki): Bonus Action, take Dodge; alternatively Bonus Action Disengage costs 0 Ki.
Step of the Wind (1 Ki): Bonus Action Dash and jump distance doubled; alternatively Bonus Action Dash may be used for 0 Ki once per turn if you do not make a Bonus Action attack that turn.
descriptions.Uncanny Metabolism: Once per recovery cycle when initiative is rolled, you may regain all expended Ki and HP equal to Monk level + one Martial Arts die.
descriptions.Deflect Attacks:
Reaction when hit by attack dealing bludgeoning/piercing/slashing: reduce damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If reduced to 0, you may spend 1 Ki to redirect: make ranged attack against creature within 60 feet using Dex/Wis; hit deals two Martial Arts dice + Dexterity modifier of original damage type.
At level 13, Deflect Energy allows this against acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, radiant, and thunder as well.
descriptions.Slow Fall: Reaction reduce falling damage by 5 × Monk level.
descriptions.Stunning Strike: Once per turn when you hit with Unarmed Strike/Monk weapon, spend 1 Ki; target makes Constitution save. Failure: Stunned until start of your next turn. Success: its Speed is halved and next attack against it before start of your next turn has advantage.
descriptions.Empowered Strikes: Unarmed Strikes count as magical and may deal force damage instead of normal type.
descriptions.Evasion: Dex save for half damage: success no damage, failure half, while not Incapacitated.
descriptions.Heightened Ki: Flurry, Patient Defense, and Step gain upgrades: Flurry may make three attacks for 1 Ki; Patient Defense grants temp HP equal Martial Arts die + Wisdom after Dodge; Step allows one willing adjacent creature to move with you up to its Speed using Reaction when you Dash.
descriptions.Self-Restoration: At end of your turn, end one of Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on yourself. If no such condition, you may suppress one level of Terravale Exhaustion's attack/check/save penalty until start next turn by spending 1 Ki; this does not remove Exhaustion.
descriptions.Tongue of the Sun and Moon: Understand all spoken languages and be understood by any creature that understands at least one language, unless magical/cognitive barriers prevent communication.
descriptions.Diamond Soul: Gain proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a save, spend 1 Ki to reroll and use new result.
descriptions.Perfect Ki: When initiative is rolled and you have fewer than 4 Ki, regain Ki until you have 4. If Uncanny Metabolism is available, you may still choose to use it instead to restore the full pool and its healing.
descriptions.Timeless Body: No need for food/water under ordinary circumstances, and ordinary aging does not impose physical frailty; you still age and can die of age according to race/canon.
descriptions.Superior Defense: Bonus Action spend 3 Ki for 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force. Ends if Incapacitated.
descriptions.Body and Mind: Dexterity and Wisdom each increase by 4, maximum 25. When initiative starts, regain Ki until you have at least 4 Ki.

descriptions.Lay on Hands: Healing pool = 5 × Paladin level HP. As Bonus Action touch yourself or willing creature and spend any number of points to restore that many HP. Spend 5 points to neutralize one ordinary poison or disease. Bespoke plagues/corruptions can state that Lay on Hands only suppresses symptoms or cannot remove them.
descriptions.Spellcasting:
Paladin is a Charisma half-caster beginning at level 1. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Charisma modifier; spell attack = PB + Charisma modifier. Prepare Charisma modifier + half Paladin level rounded up Paladin spells (minimum 1), plus always-prepared Oath spells. You may change prepared spells after the appropriate recovery/preparation period. Terravale uses the approved Paladin spell catalogue and its per-spell version rule.
Lay on Hands — level 1
Healing pool = 5 × Paladin level HP. As Bonus Action touch yourself or willing creature and spend any number of points to restore that many HP. Spend 5 points to neutralize one ordinary poison or disease. Bespoke plagues/corruptions can state that Lay on Hands only suppresses symptoms or cannot remove them.
Weapon Mastery — level 1
Master 2 weapons; after recovery replace one. Gain a third mastered weapon at level 9.
Fighting Style — level 2
Choose one Paladin-eligible Fighting Style. Replace after a Paladin level or major retraining interval.
Divine Smite — level 2
Not a spell. When you hit with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, expend one spell slot to deal 2d8 radiant extra damage for a 1st-level slot, +1d8 per slot level above 1st, maximum 5d8. Against undead/Daemon/other specifically profane creatures defined by Terravale, add +1d8. No Action or Bonus Action required. No once-per-turn restriction at present. Smite cannot be Counterspelled because it is a class feature, though effects that suppress divine/class magic may affect it.
Divine Sense — level 3
As Bonus Action, for 10 minutes you sense the presence and direction (not exact identity/stat block) of celestials, Daemons, undead, consecrated/desecrated sites, and other Oath-relevant supernatural presences within 60 feet, blocked by total cover and explicit wards. Uses = PB per recovery.
Channel Divinity — level 3
Gain Oath Channel Divinity options. Uses = 2 per recovery cycle at level 3, 3 at level 11. If a feature gives a universal Paladin Channel option, it shares this pool.
Divine Health — level 3
Immune to ordinary disease. Setting-specific diseases/corruptions may explicitly bypass or partially bypass this immunity.
Sacred Oath — level 3
Choose Oath. Features at 3, 7, 15, 20; Oath spells are always prepared. A god is not required, but violating the Oath can have narrative/mechanical consequences adjudicated with the player rather than surprise punishment.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose eligible feat or ASI.
Extra Attack — level 5
Attack twice with Attack action.
Faithful Steed — level 5
You always have an approved Find Steed-equivalent spell prepared and may cast it once per recovery without a slot. Its form must be a Terravale-valid steed/aetherfauna/spirit form approved for your Oath and culture. This does not create a permanent independent soul.
Aura of Protection — level 6
While conscious, you and allies within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to saving throws. At level 18 radius becomes 30 feet. Multiple Paladin Auras of Protection do not stack.
Abjure Foes — level 9
Channel Divinity, Action: choose up to Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures within 60 feet. Each makes Wisdom save. Failure: Frightened for 1 minute and Speed 0 while Frightened; repeat save end turns after taking damage. Success: Speed halved until end next turn.
Aura of Courage — level 10
You/allies in Aura cannot be Frightened while you are conscious.
Radiant Strikes — level 11
Once on each of your turns when you hit with melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, deal +1d8 radiant damage. You may choose another Oath-appropriate divine damage type if explicitly approved.
Cleansing Touch — level 14
Action touch yourself/willing creature and end one of: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, one spell of level ≤ your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), or one ordinary curse/disease that is not flagged resistant. Uses = Charisma modifier per recovery cycle.
Expanded Auras — level 18
All Paladin Aura features with 10-foot radius increase to 30 feet.

descriptions.Favored Enemy:
You always know Hunter's Mark (or Terravale equivalent) and it does not count against Spells Known. You may cast it without a spell slot PB times per recovery cycle; additional casts use slots normally.
In addition, when you spend at least 1 minute examining a creature, trail, lair, remains, tracks, or reliable report, you may designate that creature/type as your Studied Quarry until next recovery. You gain advantage on Survival checks to track it and Intelligence/Wisdom checks to recall its signs, habits, vulnerabilities, territory, and behaviour where such knowledge is reasonably available. You may maintain one Studied Quarry at level 1, two at level 9.
descriptions.Spellcasting:
Ranger is a Wisdom half-caster beginning at level 1. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Wisdom modifier; spell attack = PB + Wisdom modifier. Ranger uses Spells Known: 2 at level 1, 3 at 2, 4 at 3, 5 at 5, 6 at 7, 7 at 9, 8 at 11, 9 at 13, 10 at 15, 11 at 17, 12 at 19. Subclass spells do not count against this total. On gaining Ranger level, replace one known spell. Exact spell versions follow Terravale spell policy.
Favored Enemy — level 1
You always know Hunter's Mark (or Terravale equivalent) and it does not count against Spells Known. You may cast it without a spell slot PB times per recovery cycle; additional casts use slots normally.
In addition, when you spend at least 1 minute examining a creature, trail, lair, remains, tracks, or reliable report, you may designate that creature/type as your Studied Quarry until next recovery. You gain advantage on Survival checks to track it and Intelligence/Wisdom checks to recall its signs, habits, vulnerabilities, territory, and behaviour where such knowledge is reasonably available. You may maintain one Studied Quarry at level 1, two at level 9.
Weapon Mastery — level 1
Master 2 weapons; a third at level 9. Replace one after recovery.
Deft Explorer — level 2
Gain Expertise in one Ranger skill. Learn two languages or one language + tool proficiency. When traveling for an hour or more, difficult terrain does not slow your group's overland pace if caused by natural ground you can navigate, and you can remain alert while performing routine navigation/foraging.
Fighting Style — level 2
Choose Ranger-eligible Fighting Style; replace through retraining/level-up.
Ranger Archetype — level 3
Choose subclass; features at 3, 7, 11, 15.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose eligible feat or ASI.
Extra Attack — level 5
Attack twice with Attack action.
Roving — level 6
Speed +10 feet while not wearing heavy armour. Gain climb and swim Speeds equal to normal Speed.
Expertise — level 9
Gain Expertise in two additional Ranger skill/tool proficiencies.
Tireless — level 10
As Action, PB times per recovery, gain temporary HP = 1d8 + Wisdom modifier + Ranger level/2. Also, after completing the external recovery period equivalent to a long rest, reduce Terravale Exhaustion by 1 level if the recovery system permits Exhaustion removal at that interval.
Relentless Hunter — level 13
Hunter's Mark no longer requires concentration for you. You can have only one Hunter's Mark active at a time unless a subclass explicitly says otherwise. Damage cannot end it.
Nature's Veil — level 14
Bonus Action become Invisible until start of your next turn. Uses = Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per recovery cycle. The invisibility ends early if you become Incapacitated but not merely for attacking/casting during that brief duration.
Predator's Focus — level 17
When you designate a creature with Hunter's Mark, Slayer's Prey, Studied Quarry, or a subclass's equivalent quarry mechanic, choose one Focus until that mark ends:
Pursuit: +10 Speed when moving toward quarry; quarry cannot gain advantage on opportunity attacks against you.
Exposure: once per turn when you hit quarry, next ally attack against it before your next turn gains +PB to hit.
Attrition: once per turn add 1d6 damage to quarry if it is below half HP.
Only one Focus at a time.
Feral Senses — level 18
Gain Blindsight 30 feet while not Deafened to all environmental cues and not otherwise fully sensorially suppressed. Invisible creatures within range gain no advantage from invisibility against you.
Foe Slayer — level 20
When you attack your current quarry, once on each of your turns add Wisdom modifier to one attack roll or damage roll after seeing the d20 but before outcome. In addition, once per turn when you hit quarry, deal +1d10 weapon damage. If quarry is also Hunter's Marked, Hunter's Mark damage die becomes d10 for that hit.

descriptions.Sneak Attack: Once per turn, deal extra d6s equal to half Rogue level rounded up when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon attack and either have advantage or an ally/enemy-of-target is within 5 feet of target and you do not have disadvantage. Unarmed/other attacks qualify only if a feature explicitly says so.
descriptions.Thieves' Cant: Know covert underworld/institutional communication: coded speech, marks, signs, written shorthand. It is regional/cultural, not one universal language. You can teach basic recognition to allies over downtime but not full fluency instantly.
descriptions.Weapon Mastery: Master 2 finesse/ranged weapons with which proficient; third at level 10. Replace one after recovery.
descriptions.Cunning Action: Bonus Action Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
descriptions.Steady Aim: Bonus Action, only if you have not moved this turn: gain advantage on next attack this turn; after use Speed becomes 0 until turn ends.
descriptions.Cunning Strike:
When you deal Sneak Attack, you may remove Sneak Attack dice to apply one or more effects; save DC = 8 + PB + Dexterity modifier unless feature allows another ability.
Disarm (1 die): Dex save or drop one held item at feet.
Poison (1 die): Con save or Poisoned until end next turn; requires biological plausibility.
Trip (1 die): Dex save or Prone; target no more than one size larger.
Withdraw (1 die): after attack move up to half Speed without provoking.
At level 11, Improved Cunning Strike: use up to two different Cunning Strike effects on one Sneak Attack, paying dice for each.
At level 14, Devious Strikes add:
Daze (2 dice): Con save; on fail target can take Action or Bonus Action next turn, not both, and no Reactions.
Knock Out (3 dice): Con save; on fail Unconscious for 1 minute or until damaged, if creature can be knocked unconscious.
Obscure (3 dice): Dex save; on fail Blinded until end next turn.
descriptions.Uncanny Dodge: Reaction when attacker you can see hits you: halve that attack's damage after resistances/vulnerabilities are determined as normal.
descriptions.Reliable Talent: For any ability check that includes your PB, treat d20 result 9 or lower as 10.
descriptions.Evasion: Dex save for half damage: success no damage, failure half, while not Incapacitated.
descriptions.Blindsense: You know location of hidden/invisible creatures within 10 feet unless successfully hidden from all relevant senses behind total cover or using an effect explicitly defeating blindsense.
descriptions.Slippery Mind: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
descriptions.Elusive: No attack roll has advantage against you while you are not Incapacitated, unless a feature explicitly overrides Elusive.
descriptions.Stroke of Luck: Once per recovery cycle, when you miss an eligible attack, turn it into a critical hit. Alternatively, when you fail an ability check, treat the d20 as 20. You choose after seeing failure.

descriptions.Spellcasting:
Sorcerer is a Charisma Spells Known full caster. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Charisma modifier; spell attack = PB + Charisma modifier.
Cantrips Known: 4 at level 1; 5 at 4; 6 at 10.
Spells Known: 2 at level 1; then 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 22, 22, 22 at levels 2–20. Origin spells are additional. On gaining level replace one Sorcerer spell. Terravale spell-version selection remains per spell.
Sorcerous Origin — level 1
Choose Origin; features at 1, 6, 14, 18.
Innate Sorcery — level 1
Bonus Action, 2 uses per recovery cycle, enter heightened state for 1 minute. While active:
Sorcerer spell save DC +1;
advantage on attack rolls of Sorcerer spells;
visible/sensory manifestation may reflect Origin.
At level 7, Sorcery Incarnate improves this.
Font of Magic — level 2
Sorcery Points = Sorcerer level. Spend as Metamagic or create spell slots; convert slot to points equal its level as Bonus Action. Create slot costs: 2 points 1st, 3 2nd, 5 3rd, 6 4th, 7 5th. Created slots vanish on recovery and cannot exceed 5th.
Metamagic — level 2
Learn 2 options at level 2, 3 at 10, 4 at 17. Replace one when gaining Sorcerer level.
Core options:
Careful (1): up to Cha modifier creatures automatically succeed initial save against spell; if success normally halves damage, they take none only if spell is instantaneous area damage and DM approves classic behaviour.
Distant (1): double range; touch becomes 30 feet.
Empowered (1): reroll up to Cha modifier damage dice, use new; can combine with another Metamagic.
Extended (1): double duration, max 24h; advantage concentration saves for that spell.
Heightened (2): one target has disadvantage on first save against spell.
Quickened (2): Action spell becomes Bonus Action. Uses Terravale's 2014 spell-turn framework, not the 2024 one-slot-per-turn rule.
Seeking (2): reroll missed spell attack, can combine.
Subtle (1): no verbal/somatic components.
Transmuted (1): change acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison/thunder damage to another listed type.
Twinned: when an eligible spell targets only one creature and could target a second, spend Sorcery Points equal spell level (minimum 1 for cantrip) to also target a second legal creature. This preserves classic identity; spells with areas, self, multiple targets, or repeat targeting are ineligible.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose feat/ASI.
Sorcerous Restoration — level 5
When initiative starts and you have fewer Sorcery Points than PB, regain points until you equal PB. Once per recovery cycle outside initiative, after a 1-minute focused ritual regain PB Sorcery Points.
Sorcery Incarnate — level 7
When activating Innate Sorcery, regain 2 Sorcery Points. While active, you may apply two different Metamagic options to one spell even if normally only one, paying all costs. Twinned cannot combine with a second target-duplication effect.
Arcane Apotheosis — level 20
While Innate Sorcery is active, the first Metamagic you use each turn costs 1 fewer Sorcery Point (minimum 0). Once per turn when you spend Sorcery Points, roll d6; on 6, regain 1 point after effect resolves. When initiative starts, regain one Innate Sorcery use if you have none.

descriptions.Otherworldly Patron: Choose Patron; features at 1, 6, 10, 14. Patron spells are automatically known and do not count against Spells Known. Patrons remain autonomous NPC/metaphysical beings; class features represent a stable pact channel, not obedience.
descriptions.Pact Magic:
Warlock is a Charisma Spells Known Pact caster. Spell save DC = 8 + PB + Charisma modifier; spell attack = PB + Charisma modifier.
Cantrips Known: 2 at level 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 10.
Spells Known: 2 at level 1, then 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,10,11,11,12,12,13,13,14,14,15,15 at levels 2–20, plus Patron spells.
Pact slot number/level is shown in table; all Pact slots have same level. Recovery follows Terravale's faster class-resource cadence. Mystic Arcanum is separate.
Otherworldly Patron — level 1
Choose Patron; features at 1, 6, 10, 14. Patron spells are automatically known and do not count against Spells Known. Patrons remain autonomous NPC/metaphysical beings; class features represent a stable pact channel, not obedience.
Eldritch Invocations — level 1
Learn 1 Invocation at level 1, 2 at 2, 3 at 5, 4 at 7, 5 at 9, 6 at 12, 7 at 15, 8 at 18. Replace one on gaining Warlock level. Invocations may grant spells, modify cantrips/Pact Gifts, senses, movement, curses, etc. Eldritch Blast is not mandatory.
Magical Cunning — level 2
Once per recovery cycle, perform a 1-minute ritual and regain expended Pact slots equal to half your maximum Pact slots rounded up. You cannot use this during combat unless a feature specifically allows the ritual under pressure.
Pact Gift — level 3
Choose one foundational Gift. It can be deepened by Invocations.
Pact of the Blade. Bonus Action create/bind one pact weapon. You are proficient; may use Charisma for attack/damage; gain Weapon Mastery with that weapon if it is eligible. It counts magical. You may dismiss/summon while on same accessible plane/realm. Heavy weapons require Strength 13 unless Invocation says otherwise.
Pact of the Chain. Learn Find Familiar-equivalent and can summon an expanded familiar/servitor from Patron-appropriate list. Familiar can attack when you forgo one of your attacks or use Bonus Action, depending stat block. It is not an Eidolon and does not imply ownership of a soul-bearing person.
Pact of the Tome. Receive Book of Shadows. Learn 3 cantrips from any class lists; they are Warlock cantrips. After 1 hour ritual, inscribe ritual spells you find if spell level ≤ half Warlock level rounded up and DM permits; you may cast inscribed rituals as rituals.
Feat / Ability Score Improvement — levels 4, 8, 12, 16, 19
Choose feat/ASI.
Contact Patron — level 9
You always know Contact Other Plane-equivalent or a Patron-contact rite. Once per recovery cast/perform it targeting your Patron without spell slot and without risk of generic insanity table. Patron can refuse unknown information, answer symbolically, lie if their nature permits, or decline if unreachable; the contact itself reliably opens the channel unless blocked by Null/Sealing.
Mystic Arcanum — levels 11, 13, 15, 17
Choose one Warlock spell of 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th level respectively. Cast each chosen Arcanum once per recovery cycle without Pact slot. When gaining Warlock level, replace an Arcanum with another of same level if desired.
Eldritch Master — level 20
Once per recovery cycle as a Bonus Action, immediately regain all expended Pact slots and one expended use of Magical Cunning. If your Patron relationship is temporarily severed, the feature may instead draw on the pact mark/bond itself unless canon says the pact has been destroyed. This is the final Terravale capstone for this rules pass.

You may dismiss/summon while on same accessible plane/realm. Heavy weapons require Strength 13 unless Invocation says otherwise.
Pact of the Chain. Learn Find Familiar-equivalent and can summon an expanded familiar/servitor from Patron-appropriate list. Familiar can attack when you forgo one of your attacks or use Bonus Action, depending stat block. It is not an Eidolon and does not imply ownership of a soul-bearing person.
Pact of the Tome. Receive Book of Shadows. Learn 3 cantrips from any class lists; they are Warlock cantrips. After 1 hour ritual, inscribe ritual spells you find if spell level ≤ half Warlock level rounded up and DM permits; you may cast inscribed rituals as rituals.
descriptions.Contact Patron: You always know Contact Other Plane-equivalent or a Patron-contact rite. Once per recovery cast/perform it targeting your Patron without spell slot and without risk of generic insanity table. Patron can refuse unknown information, answer symbolically, lie if their nature permits, or decline if unreachable; the contact itself reliably opens the channel unless blocked by Null/Sealing.
descriptions.Eldritch Master: Once per recovery cycle as a Bonus Action, immediately regain all expended Pact slots and one expended use of Magical Cunning. If your Patron relationship is temporarily severed, the feature may instead draw on the pact mark/bond itself unless canon says the pact has been destroyed. This is the final Terravale capstone for this rules pass.

descriptions.Arcane Recovery: Once per recovery cycle after at least 1 minute of study/meditation outside combat, recover expended spell slots with combined level equal to half Wizard level rounded up, no slot above 5th.
descriptions.Cantrip Formula: After each recovery/preparation period, replace one Wizard cantrip with another Wizard cantrip in your spellbook/research access.
descriptions.Scholar: Gain Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion in which proficient. If none, gain proficiency first and Expertise at level 5.
descriptions.Memorize Spell: After 1 minute studying spellbook, replace one prepared Wizard spell with another spell in book. Uses = PB per recovery cycle. Cannot change cantrips with this feature.
descriptions.Spell Mastery: Choose one 1st-level and one 2nd-level Wizard spell in spellbook with Action casting time. They are always prepared and can be cast at base level without expending a slot. Replace either after 8 hours study/research interval. A spell with costly/consumed material component is ineligible.
descriptions.Signature Spells: Choose two 3rd-level Wizard spells in spellbook. They are always prepared and each can be cast at 3rd level once per recovery cycle without a slot. After both free uses are spent, cast normally with slots. Replace after 8 hours study.

descriptions.Spirit Sense: Spirit Sense — Lv1. Action: sense obvious spiritual activity/state within 30 ft until next turn. 60 ft at Lv9; always-on 60 ft at Lv18 unless concealed. No stat-block vision, True Names or generic magic radar.
descriptions.Bonds: Spirit Bonds — Lv1. Start with 2; gain another at 5/11/17. Each has Presence, Invocation, Deep Invocation (Lv5), Embodiment (Lv11) and Greater Embodiment (Lv17). Each Bond represents an actual relationship; levelling gives capacity and the DM should provide a reasonable path to establish it. Bonds may be reskinned for individual spirits; two Bonds of the same Nature require DM approval.
descriptions.Channel: Channel Spirit — Lv1. Bonus Action: channel or switch one Bond. Gain its Presence until you switch, end Channeling, become incapacitated or the connection is severed. Channeling does not automatically summon a visible creature.
descriptions.Favour: Spirit Favour — Lv2. Gain the dice shown above. Invocations ordinarily cost 1 Favour die; add dice only when specified. Roll a spent die only when the feature calls for its result. Recover Favour using Terravale's external class-resource cadence.
descriptions.Rites: Spirit Rites — Lv2. Learn the listed number. Rites use both hands/voice or equivalent and a spiritual focus unless stated otherwise. They are not spells unless specified and are not ordinarily Counterspell targets; Null and supernatural suppression may interfere.
descriptions.Offerings & Petitions: Offerings & Petitions — Lv2. Negotiate with spirits for benefits outside written abilities. The DM weighs spirit, relationship, request and offering: yes, conditional yes, counteroffer, delay or refusal. Written class features work without constant offerings.
descriptions.Tradition: Tradition — Lv3. Choose one. Features at 3/6/10/14.
descriptions.Deep Invocation: Deepened Invocation — Lv5. Spend 1 additional Favour die on a Bond Invocation to use its Deep form.
descriptions.3rd Bond: Spirit Bonds — Lv1. Start with 2; gain another at 5/11/17. Each has Presence, Invocation, Deep Invocation (Lv5), Embodiment (Lv11) and Greater Embodiment (Lv17). Each Bond represents an actual relationship; levelling gives capacity and the DM should provide a reasonable path to establish it. Bonds may be reskinned for individual spirits; two Bonds of the same Nature require DM approval.
descriptions.Spirit Ward: Spirit Ward — Lv7. Advantage on saves vs possession or forcible spiritual domination/inhabitation. Reaction: when a creature you can see within 30 ft fails such a save, spend 1 Favour die and add its result, possibly turning failure into success.
descriptions.Greater Petition: Greater Petition — Lv9. Once per external recovery cycle, add PB to a DM-requested check/roll adjudicating a substantial, plausible Petition to an established Bond or local spirit. No automatic obedience.
descriptions.Embodiment: Embodiment — Lv11. While Channeling, Bonus Action + 2 Favour dice to gain that Bond's Embodiment for 1 minute; end freely. Only one spirit Embodied at a time. Ordinary class use cannot let the spirit permanently seize your character.
descriptions.4th Bond: Spirit Bonds — Lv1. Start with 2; gain another at 5/11/17. Each has Presence, Invocation, Deep Invocation (Lv5), Embodiment (Lv11) and Greater Embodiment (Lv17). Each Bond represents an actual relationship; levelling gives capacity and the DM should provide a reasonable path to establish it. Bonds may be reskinned for individual spirits; two Bonds of the same Nature require DM approval.
descriptions.Spirit Crossing: Spirit Crossing — Lv13. Action + 2 Favour dice; up to 10 minutes. Perceive/interact with inaccessible incorporeal spirits, follow genuine spirit-paths and cross minor open spiritual thresholds at DM discretion. Not unrestricted teleportation/planar travel.
descriptions.Shared Invocation: Shared Invocation — Lv15. When using a Presence or Invocation, spend 1 Favour die to share an approved lesser version with one willing creature within 30 ft until the start of your next turn (or shorter original duration). Each creature may hold only one of yours at a time.
descriptions.Greater Embodiment: Greater Embodiment — Lv17. Embodiment costs 1 Favour die and lasts up to 10 minutes; also gain the Bond's Greater effect.
descriptions.5th Bond: Spirit Bonds — Lv1. Start with 2; gain another at 5/11/17. Each has Presence, Invocation, Deep Invocation (Lv5), Embodiment (Lv11) and Greater Embodiment (Lv17). Each Bond represents an actual relationship; levelling gives capacity and the DM should provide a reasonable path to establish it. Bonds may be reskinned for individual spirits; two Bonds of the same Nature require DM approval.
descriptions.Walker Between Worlds: Walker Between Worlds — Lv18. Basic communication with communicative spirits regardless of language; Spirit Sense always on 60 ft; advantage to detect false spirit identities, possession traces and manipulated spirit-sign.
descriptions.Living Threshold: Living Threshold — Lv20. Channel 2 Bonds and gain both Presences; Embody one while retaining the other Presence. Once on each of your turns, the first Favour die you would spend is free. You cannot be unwillingly possessed by an effect that permits a save; if it normally bypasses saves, you instead gain a Charisma save vs its source DC (or DC 20).
descriptions.Read the Trace: Read the Trace — 1 min, free. Check a place, object or creature for spiritual activity from roughly the previous 24h. Investigation/Spirit check may reveal direction, mood and age.
descriptions.Invite the Local: Invite the Local — 10 min, 1 Favour or suitable offering. Invite, not compel, a local spirit. If it answers, exchange basic meaning/images/emotion for 10 min without a shared language.
descriptions.Threshold Ward: Threshold Ward — 10 min, 1 Favour, 8h. Ward doorway/window/10-ft boundary. Hostile spirit crossing: Wis save; fail = blocked until next turn + you are alerted.
descriptions.Quiet the Haunting: Quiet the Haunting — 10 min, 1 Favour. Suppress non-sapient haunting in 20-ft radius for 1h. Autonomous spirit may attempt Cha save; failure suppresses disruptive environmental effects, not the spirit itself.
descriptions.Cleanse Spiritual Contamination: Cleanse Spiritual Contamination — 10 min, 1 Favour. Remove one minor spiritual taint/residue/nightmare/curse-like contamination from creature/object/5-ft area. Major curse/Null/Eldritch scar may only be identified.
descriptions.Prepare the Dead: Prepare the Dead — 10 min, free + offering. Protect remains from ordinary possession/necromantic disturbance/scavenging spirits/accidental haunting for 7 days. Legitimate resurrection/death systems unaffected.
descriptions.Dream Shelter: Dream Shelter — 10 min, 1 Favour, until waking/next recovery. Up to PB sleeping creatures within 20 ft have advantage on saves vs supernatural nightmares, dream intrusion and hostile spirit contact. Does not guarantee a safe rest.
descriptions.Omen Casting: Omen Casting — 10 min, 1 Favour + offering. Ask about a specific action within 24h; receive a favourable / dangerous / mixed / obscured omen based on available spiritual signs, not certain prophecy.
descriptions.Binding Circle: Binding Circle — 1 min, 2 Favour, lasts 10 min. 10-ft radius. Spirit/possessing/incorporeal entity within must pass Cha save to exit; success permits exit and breaks circle for that entity. Not effective against divine/Primal-scale beings or Null.
descriptions.Spirit Lantern: Spirit Lantern — Action, 1 Favour, 10 min. 20-ft dim aura; invisible incorporeal/ghostly creatures lose invisibility benefit vs you; spiritual traces show. Normal invisibility unaffected.
descriptions.Soothe the Possessed: Soothe the Possessed — Action, 1 Favour. A possessed/spiritually dominated creature within 30 ft repeats its save with advantage; success expels the possessor to adjacent space if possible, or ends suppression/domination. Once per recovery against the same source.
descriptions.Road of Safe Return: Road of Safe Return — Lv13, 10 min, 2 Favour. Mark up to PB creatures before Spirit Crossing. For 1h, if separated, each may Action once to return to marked origin unless Seal/Null blocks it.
descriptions.Ember:
Presence: environmental heat resistance; once/turn fire/radiant damage +PB.
Invocation: target 30 ft, Dex save; Favour + Wis fire/radiant, half success; ally instead gets equal temp HP.
Deep: 10-ft burst around target; enemies take 2 Favour dice damage (Dex save for half); on failure lose Reactions until next turn.
Embodiment: fire resistance; once/turn weapon/Unarmed hit +1 Favour die fire; bright light 20 ft.
Greater: fire immunity; once/turn melee attacker takes Wis + PB fire.
descriptions.River:
Presence: swim = Speed; advantage footing/currents/escape Grapple.
Invocation: Reaction, you/ally 30 ft reduces damage by Favour + Wis and may move 5 ft without provoking.
Deep: 2 Favour + Wis, move up to 15 ft.
Embodiment: water breathing; swim +20; pass through one-size-larger creatures as difficult terrain; once/turn move 10 ft after Invocation.
Greater: bludgeoning + cold resistance; squeeze through 1-inch gaps if gear can pass/merge.
descriptions.Stone:
Presence: advantage vs forced movement; carry/push as one size larger.
Invocation: Reaction, you/ally 30 ft moved/knocked Prone → reduce movement by 5 × Favour result ft and add die to save/check.
Deep: resistance to triggering damage; may stay standing after failed knockdown if possible.
Embodiment: +1 AC; resist forced movement; unarmed may use Wis and deal Favour die bludgeoning.
Greater: +2 AC total, bludgeoning resistance from attacks, -5 Speed.
descriptions.Hunt:
Presence: advantage tracking + scent/hearing Perception; +10 Speed toward creature damaged since last turn.
Invocation: Bonus Action mark visible target 60 ft until next turn; first attack by you/ally gains Favour die to attack or damage.
Deep: 1 min, concentration-like; once/round first ally hit adds Favour die damage.
Embodiment: darkvision +60, Speed +10, climb = Speed; once/turn after moving 10 ft toward prey add Favour damage.
Greater: blindsight 10 ft; opportunity attacks vs marked prey advantage.
descriptions.Hearth:
Presence: while conscious, you/allies within 5 ft gain +PB to saves vs Frightened.
Invocation: Action or Bonus Action chosen when Bond forms; target 30 ft gets temp HP Favour + Wis + PB.
Deep: up to PB creatures get Favour + Wis temp HP; one may stand from Prone.
Embodiment: 10-ft aura; allies with no temp HP gain PB temp HP and advantage vs Charm/Fear.
Greater: aura 20 ft; once/round Reaction reduce ally damage by Favour die, no extra die spent.
descriptions.Grave:
Presence: advantage identifying undead/burial disturbance/death magic/anchored ghosts; see obvious ghosts 30 ft.
Invocation: Action target 30 ft: stabilise + restore Favour HP if at 0, OR undead/hostile spirit Wis save vs Favour + Wis necrotic/radiant.
Deep: heal 2 dice, OR target cannot regain HP until next turn.
Embodiment: necrotic resistance; advantage death saves; pass through hostile undead spaces as difficult terrain without provoking.
Greater: once/round when a creature within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, Reaction move half Speed toward it and use base Invocation for free. Cannot reap/capture souls.
descriptions.Grove:
Presence: advantage Nature/natural difficult-terrain checks; mundane plants do not hinder.
Invocation: 10-ft square within 60 ft = enemy difficult terrain until next turn; one creature Str save or Restrained until your next turn.
Deep: 20-ft square, 1 min, repeat save end of turns.
Embodiment: +1 AC, climb Speed; start turn on natural ground with no temp HP → PB temp HP.
Greater: poison resistance; allies in 10-ft aura gain +2 AC vs ranged attacks through your vegetation/roots.
descriptions.Storm:
Presence: advantage severe wind/weather; jump +PB ft.
Invocation: target 60 ft, Dex save; fail = Favour + Wis lightning/thunder + 10-ft push, success half/no push.
Deep: 30-ft line or 10-ft burst, 2 Favour damage, push 15 ft.
Embodiment: choose lightning/thunder resistance; Speed +10; hover 5 ft while moving.
Greater: fly = Speed during turn; unsupported at end → safely descend up to 60 ft.
descriptions.Veil:
Presence: advantage detecting illusions/concealment/spiritual disguise; dim light does not disadvantage Perception.
Invocation: Bonus Action self/ally 30 ft; until next turn attacks from >10 ft have disadvantage.
Deep: Invisible until next turn; ends on attack/damage/overt spell.
Embodiment: see Invisible 10 ft; pass through one creature/turn; opportunity attacks against you disadvantage.
Greater: see spiritual overlap 30 ft; once/turn teleport 10 ft between dim/obscured spaces.
descriptions.Memory:
Presence: advantage History/recalling witnessed details; perfect recall while channelled.
Invocation: Reaction when a creature you can perceive within 30 ft fails an Int/Wis/Cha check/save; add Favour die if it can perceive you and remembered knowledge/identity could help.
Deep: if success is created, advantage on next related check/save within 1 min.
Embodiment: proficiency all Intelligence checks; if already proficient add half PB again; memory cannot be read/altered without save.
Greater: once/round replace you/ally's Int/Wis/Cha d20 within 30 ft with 10 before modifiers, free.
descriptions.Moon:
Presence: darkvision 60 ft or +30 existing; advantage Navigation/Survival at night.
Invocation: target 60 ft: temp HP Favour + Wis, OR Wis save or disadvantage on next attack before your next turn.
Deep: affect 2 targets, or one target gets double Favour dice.
Embodiment: choose radiant/psychic resistance; dim light 10 ft; Bonus Action teleport 15 ft in dim light PB times per Embodiment.
Greater: teleport 30 ft and bring one willing adjacent creature.
descriptions.The Vessel:
3 — Open Vessel: Bonus Action deepen channel 1 min, PB uses/recovery. Numerical Presence improves by PB or one Favour die as appropriate; nonnumerical gets advantage on directly supported checks. Once/turn after Invocation gain temp HP = Wis.
6 — Shared Flesh: while Deepened choose one approved trait: climb/swim/fly during turn; +1 AC; darkvision/blindsight 10 ft; elemental resistance; natural weapon using Favour die.
10 — Safe Possession: Embodiment costs 1 fewer die, min 1; advantage vs involuntary possession/identity alteration; once/Embodiment turn one failed such save into success.
14 — Two Voices, One Body: during Embodiment keep second Bond's Presence; once/turn after embodied Invocation, use second Bond's basic Invocation as Bonus Action for 1 Favour.
descriptions.The Warden:
3 — Warding Sigils: learn Threshold Ward and Anchor Ward in addition to normal Rites. Anchor Ward: Action, creature within 30 ft gains advantage vs possession/forced teleport until next turn. Either Ward used in combat costs 1 Favour die.
6 — Exorcist's Rebuke: Reaction when a spirit, possessor, curse-manifestation, summoned or incorporeal entity within 30 ft uses a supernatural feature. Spend/roll 1 Favour die to subtract from its attack/save-DC outcome or deal 2× die result force/spirit damage. If subtraction causes failure, push the manifestation 10 ft.
10 — Circle of Refusal: Action + 2 Favour, 15-ft aura, 1 min. Hostile spirits/summons entering/starting: Wis save; fail = Speed 0 and cannot possess/teleport that turn. Allies advantage vs Charm/Fear/Possession.
14 — Seal the Unwelcome: once/recovery, qualifying entity 60 ft below half HP or failing your Rite save → Cha save vs Shaman DC; fail = expelled/suppressed 1 min or returned to proper local layer. Does not uninstall gods/bosses.
descriptions.The Ancestor Keeper:
3 — Keeper of Names: History or Religion proficiency (expertise if already proficient). 10-min rite at grave/relic/community record: ask one question of residual ancestral memory if soul law permits; no soul summoning. Ancestral Counsel: PB times/recovery, add Favour die after an ally's skill/save roll when memory, duty, lineage, craft or survival is relevant.
6 — Inherited Skill: after recovery, choose one justified ancestral/community/taught skill, tool or weapon tradition; gain proficiency, or expertise if already proficient in the skill. Change after a meaningful ancestral rite.
10 — Stand Behind Me: Reaction, ally 30 ft takes damage → 1 Favour reduces by die + Wis + half Shaman level; ally advantage on next save before your next turn.
14 — Procession of the Remembered: once/recovery; 1 min; 20-ft aura. Chosen allies gain +PB to death saves and checks vs fear/charm; once/round add 1 Favour die free to an ally's missed attack/failed save. Uses legitimate ancestral echoes where available, otherwise memory-imprints/resonance, never involuntary soul summoning.
descriptions.The Spiritwalker:
3 — Between-Step: Bonus Action + 1 Favour teleport 5 × die result ft to visible space; instead pass through one occupied square/5 ft non-warded solid material and emerge adjacent. No Null/Seals.
6 — Far Hearing: while Channeling, sense bonded spirits/major spirit activity within 1 mile on the same local spiritual layer. 10-min rite: project senses to a known spirit-path location within 1 mile for up to 10 min; body is unaware of its surroundings.
10 — Escort the Living: Spirit Crossing may bring up to PB willing creatures touching you; each uses its Reaction and arrives adjacent. Spiritual-layer stay lasts at most 10 min; party returns together unless local rules permit otherwise.
14 — Path Without Road: once/recovery, 1-min rite; travel with up to 8 creatures between known spirit-thresholds within 10 miles. Wards, Null, hostile territory or disconnected cosmology may redirect or prevent travel.
descriptions.The Wild Speaker:
Ordinary natural/local spirits and ecologies, not true Primals by default.
3 — Local Kinship: Nature/Survival proficiency/expertise; communicate simple ideas with Beasts, aware plants and ordinary nature spirits. After 10 min in a new natural region, learn one truthful environmental fact.
6 — Borrowed Adaptation: while Channeling choose climb Speed; swim + water breathing; darkvision 60 ft; +10 Speed; or one supported environmental damage resistance. 1 Favour gives it to ally for 10 min.
10 — Land Answers: Action + 2 Favour, 20-ft area, 1 min. Enemy difficult terrain; allies ignore natural difficult terrain + gain half cover from natural features. Once/turn move one ally 10 ft via environment.
14 — Great Local Pact: after 10-min Petition gain one Regional Boon until leaving region or next recovery: safe-passage signs, weather warning, hidden route, enhanced forage, or +1 AC / +10 Speed in region. Bigger asks remain Petitions.
